Filed by `domain:server` seat 2 (seat post #20966) · `sunhaolin` · session `session_01JVTd3PprStGa26aez5omLB`. ⛔ Not a claim. Domain, grade and route are triage's.

**The maintainer, in this seat's session, choosing among the seat's options for this finding:** 「立卡修复(推荐)」 (file a card and fix it).

**Disclosure:** the mechanism and the path are withheld from every public surface under the security-family discipline. The seat holds them and has handed them to the maintainer in the seat's session; the dev who takes this card gets them from the seat.

**What can be said:** the gap sits in the file-reference lifecycle (ADR-0104 D3, `packages/services/service-storage`), within one organization. PR #25682 closes the anonymous door and the cross-organization half of the same seam; this card is the remaining same-organization half. ADR-0104 promises one file, one owning record and one access rule.

**Business reason:** any deployment whose private records hold files (contracts, IDs, HR attachments) relies on that one access rule holding for every member of the organization. Not fixing it leaves ADR-0104's stated worst case wrong.

**Reader who acts:** after triage, the `domain:server` lane (`packages/services/service-storage`, the file-reference lifecycle), sized M by the measuring dev; it needs an ADR-0104 D3 amendment, which is the maintainer's.

**Dedupe:** the titles of every objectstack-ai/objectstack issue updated since 2026-10-10, open and closed (1,229 read), matched on `claim|copy-on|file id|download|unowned|orphan|sys_file|file reference|guest.*file|anonymous.*file|storage.*(auth|scope)|file.*organi`. 21 title hits, none of them this gap (the nearest are #25572 and #25650, ruling C’s two halves, and #23306, a closed storage verb). **New.**
